events.title: Major Graphics Overhaul: A New Visual Experience
events.summary: Main Character Model Refresh Enhanced Design: The main character model now has a lower poly count for a cleaner, more cohesive look that fits well with the low-poly environment. The mesh has been refined with smoother, rounded shapes to prevent the character from looking out of place. Character Detail: Subtle vines now adorn the character’s body, adding a sense of depth and personality.
